# Genderize

Genderize is an API that predicts the gender of a person based on their first name, providing statistical probabilities for male or female classifications.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/genderize/.

## Actions

- **Batch Predict Gender with Localization** (read-only): Predict genders for a batch of names with optional country localization.
- **Predict Gender** (read-only): Predict gender from a given first name.
- **Predict Gender Batch** (read-only): Predict gender for multiple names in a single request.
